event_description: A visitor chose Own this or Rent here on the City Receipt (never the address).
A City Receipt result appeared, with its kind (estimate, exempt…) and whether it came from an address or a typed value.
The receipt picture was shared from the phone share sheet or downloaded.
The chat panel was opened from the header button.
A news topic's Ask about link sent its prepared question (topic id only).
A source mark opened a budget page in the PDF drawer (document and page).
The Council budget calendar file was downloaded.
A news headline was opened (outlet and topic).
